title: Kenyan-Style Roast Chicken
description: A flavorful and aromatic roast chicken dish inspired by Kenyan cuisine, made with juicy chicken and a blend of spices.
instructions: Rinse the chicken and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, curry powder, and paprika.
Heat oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken on all sides until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast the chicken for 30-40 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
While the chicken is roasting, toss the chopped potatoes with oil, salt, and black pepper in a separate bowl.
After 20 minutes of roasting the chicken, add the potatoes to the oven and continue roasting for another 20-25 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown.
Remove the chicken and potatoes from the oven and let them rest for 5-10 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped onion, garlic, and ginger, if desired.
